MRI Safety Information
The Garnet Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. A person with the Garnet Coronary Stent System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Garnet Coronary Stent System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T or 3.0 T
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 10 T/m
RF Coil Type Head Transmit/Receive Coil ONLY
Receive with the head transmit/receive coil
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.5 W/kg
